name: live-panel
category: Visualization · System description → always-running architecture panel (mp4 or live page)
description: Render a JSON description of a running system as an always-running architecture panel: fixed layout, packets on the wires, scrolling log, counters, gauges that flip state past a threshold, and side triggers that light in turn. Outputs an H.264 mp4 for X or Xiaohongshu, or a self-contained page that runs live in any browser. Deterministic replay, plus headless checks for geometry, replay identity and log-versus-panel agreement.
